crossRefs.note: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be…
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and…
The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of…
The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of…
He trusted in Yahweh, the God of Israel; so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among…
Rabshakeh said to them, “Say now to Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in…
‘Tell Hezekiah king of Judah this: “Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem will not be…
“Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is…
Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out…
My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Rabshakeh
people.line: A Babylonian official who taunted Hezekiah and Jerusalem's people

translations.web: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?
translations.bsb: The Rabshakeh said to them, “Tell Hezekiah that this is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What is the basis of this confidence of yours?
translations.kjv: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
translations.asv: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
